expectations.text: Distinguishes this pattern from DevRel's gatekeeper/pit-trap taxonomy rather than relabeling that taxonomy
expectations.evidence: The transcript never mentions DevRel's gatekeeper or pit-trap taxonomy, so it makes no explicit distinction. It does avoid relabeling: it calls the build/outreach/growth stacking a 'scope-collapse test' and says this 'is a structural inference from Postman's small-team data... not a named industry diagnosis.' It also separates DevRel work (the blog and office hours) from external-API platform engineering. That hedge only partly meets the item, because the transcript never sets the pattern against the gatekeeper/pit-trap framing.

expectations.evidence: The transcript never mentions the gatekeeper/pit-trap taxonomy and never compares the job-post problem to it. It critiques a hybrid API-platform/DevRel job description: four jobs in one, an undecided manager, an outcome target the hire doesn't control, and similar gaps. Because the taxonomy never appears, there is no distinction from it and no relabeling of it.
